Description
Overview
The ProLine is a modular universal materials testing machine designed for standardized materials testing and component function testing. Manufactured by ZwickRoell in Germany, ProLine systems combine mechanical, electronic and software components to deliver precise, repeatable test results and straightforward operation.
Product properties
Industries: universal / cross-industry applications
Test load range: 5 kN – 100 kN (model-dependent)
Test types: tensile, compression, flexure, cyclic tests
Typical applications: connector and spring-contact tests, joining/pressing checks, ring stiffness on reels and pipes, packaging stackability, open/close cycles, pull-off, tear-growth and adhesion tests
Advantages and features
Description of application
ProLine is optimized for standardized and component-level testing where compact footprint, ease of use and precise motion control are required. Typical use cases include electrical contact testing, precision mechanical joining checks, packaging and food-industry component tests.
Integrated safety in accordance with the EC Machinery Directive
The system meets EC Machinery Directive requirements with documented conformity. Safety features include two-channel safety circuits, electrical interlocking and mechanical guard locking, crosshead limit and drive-off switches, motor brake and operation mode switch.
Powerful drives
Extremely low minimum speeds with high speed stability and fine crosshead travel resolution for precise component tests
Wide usable speed range; permissible test loads up to 110% of nominal to compensate for heavy fixtures
High return speeds reduce cycle time; maintenance-free AC motor technology
High stiffness and precise crosshead guidance
Two steel columns and a stiff load-frame profile ensure minimal crosshead inclination and accurate force application, beneficial for flexure, compression and precision component tests.
Safety for the complete testing system
Comprehensive safety: two-channel safety circuit, crosshead limit switch, drive-Off switch, motor brake function and operation mode switch ensure safe operation and protect users and equipment during tests.
Mechanical modularity
Modular mechanical design allows fast adaptation via a plug and T-slot system and a wide range of ZwickRoell grips, fixtures and custom devices for varied testing scenarios.
Technical overview
Available speeds (example): 0.0005 mm/min to 1500 mm/min (model-dependent)
Permissible test loads up to 110% of nominal for compensation of heavy fixtures
Available test loads: 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100 kN
Test area heights: approx. 1050 mm to 1470 mm depending on model
Crosshead travel: approx. 980 mm to 1400 mm depending on model
Drive travel resolution examples: 0.0115 µm to 0.0348 µm
Operable with standard PC or laptop; compatible with ZwickRoell testing software
